answer: Hide surprise tasks among real ones. Each epoch the chain sends every identity one task sealed with a cipher that unlocks at a random block, and allows 90 seconds to answer. A farm of 400 clones on one model must then run 400 inference slots in the same window, and any two answers whose edit delta is under 5 percent both lose a 25 POA bond. One operator can feed a few heads cheaply, but a reef of clones that all move at once is easy to spot, and each extra head adds fixed cost.
